assumptions: Every cron fires on schedule for the full configured month; missed, overlapping, and retried runs are not modeled.
Each crawl tick claims its full configured batch. Empty queues therefore make the estimate conservative for function calls and database proxy units.
Brawl crawl uses one battle-log request per target and at most one profile request when its separate 12-hour profile cadence is due; the model uses the two-request upper bound.
Jobs with dailyUpstreamRequestCap apply the repository's hard reservation limit to upstream totals even though function/database proxy units remain conservative full-batch estimates.
Child calls are approximate Convex ctx.runQuery/ctx.runMutation calls per run and per work item; database work inside those calls is not counted as another child call.
Rough database reads and writes are proxy row-operation units, not Convex invoice units or live dashboard readings.
The estimate excludes frontend traffic, manual lookups, retries, storage, bandwidth, and data-dependent prune work. Hub profile refresh is included as a worst-case mixed-adapter lane.

jobs.name: crawl due player logs
jobs.notes: Two calls per item is an upper bound: every target fetches a battle log, while profiles refresh separately about every 12 hours. The shared 500/hour crawl budget is enforced in code.

jobs.name: discover ranked players and clubs
jobs.notes: Batch is BRAWL_CLUB_SEED; fixed requests are player and club rankings.

jobs.name: crawl battle logs
jobs.notes: One battle-log fetch per target, capped at 8 per run and 4,000 per UTC day; optional sighting writes are not itemized.

jobs.name: discover leaderboard and clan targets
jobs.notes: The 12-request per-run cap covers leaderboards, the active board, clan rankings, and at most nine clan rosters.

jobs.name: roll up deck rankings
jobs.notes: Worst-case bounded proxy for ten exact boards: 250 indexed candidates plus up to 200 prior rows per board; normalization and publication occur on separate runs.

jobs.name: observe tracked clans
jobs.notes: At most three renewable seven-day watches are polled per run; the 36-request daily cap permits at most 12 full clan observations per UTC day.

jobs.name: refresh due connected and watched players
jobs.notes: Worst case assumes every due target uses the three-request Clash adapter. The default 480-target daily reservation cap limits this lane to 1,440 upstream calls; Brawl uses one cached service request that can fan into at most two budgeted upstream calls.
